title: Cross-validation of marketfauna.com/wba-fixtures request cases against Cloudflare's reference verifier
method: Each request case is verified with web-bot-auth verify() at its own 'now' (per-case clock).
Resolver returns the RFC 9421 Appendix B.1.4 Ed25519 test key only for its JWK thumbprint keyid; any other keyid throws.
validate() keeps one in-memory nonce set across the batch, in file order, so the replay case sees the valid case's nonce.
Directory cases were not run: this script exercises request verification only.
summary: 8 of 8 request cases match the expected verdict
